hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Post-order depth-first traversal evaluates subtree states from leaves upward.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Track two remainder frequency arrays representing whether the current node is included or excluded.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Combine child branch combinations using modular convolution over remainder states.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Tree DP convolves child remainder combinations modulo k at each vertex.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive subset generation takes 2^n time which is prohibitive.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Retains DP remainder arrays of size k along recursion call stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models tree non-adjacency with 2-state modular knapsack DP.
